note: Reference catalog example only. Values are never stored here. Resolution is read-only and requires a runtime-authorized secret store that I01 deliberately does not implement; every ref stays NOT_PROVISIONED until such a store exists. Existing service configuration locators are metadata only. NOT_PROVISIONED refers to purpose-bound runtime credentials; existing files do not authorize resolution or reuse. Publisher, isolator and issuer material is not inferred from an owner account.
